Anchor.description: Represents an anchor point for lineage statements on external systems

locations.description: Storage locations where the statements are anchored

statements.description: List of statement identifiers or full statements being anchored

AssociationStatement.description:
Records an association between a subject and another entity

This statement type is used to create relationships between artifacts,
such as linking data to its metadata, or connecting related entities.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

subject.description: The subject of the association (CID or DID)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

ComputationStatement.description:
Records a computational process with its inputs and outputs

This statement type captures the lineage of data transformations,
including the computation performed, input data, output data,
and the entity that executed the computation.

computation.description: Optional CID of the computation definition or code

executedOn.description: Optional identifier of the system where computation was executed

input.description: Input data CIDs (single value or array)

operatedBy.description: DID of the entity that operated the computation

output.description: Output data CIDs (single value or array)

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

DataStatement.description:
Records the registration of data artifacts

This statement type is used to register one or more data artifacts
in the lineage system, establishing their existence and provenance.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

DidStatement.description: Enum representing different types of DID registration statements

issue_vc.description: Set to `true` to create a verifiable credential for the statement.

timestamp.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp to embed in the DID statement.

DidStatementRegular.description:
Regular DID registration statement without verified computing attestation

This statement type registers a decentralized identifier (DID) without
any additional attestation or verification information.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

DsseStatement.description:
Records a credential in DSSE (Dead Simple Signing Envelope) format

This statement type stores verifiable credentials that have been signed
using the DSSE specification, providing cryptographic proof of authenticity.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

EntityStatement.description:
Records the registration of entities in the lineage system

This statement type registers entities (organizations, systems, or agents)
that participate in lineage events, identified by UUIDs.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

Envelope.description:
Serializable DSSE envelope for lineage data.

Contains a payload and one or more signatures for secure transmission
and storage of lineage statements.

GovernanceStatement.description:
Records governance information for a subject

This statement type associates governance documents (policies, procedures,
compliance documents) with subjects in the lineage system.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

subject.description: The subject to which governance applies

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

topicId.description: HCS topic identifier where the statement was anchored

urls.description: Optional URLs for accessing the anchored data

tokenId.description: HTS token identifier where the statement was anchored

urls.description: Optional URLs for accessing the anchored data

Manifest.description:
A manifest packages statements, contexts, and blobs for distribution.

Version 3 manifest format that bundles statements with their JSON-LD contexts,
binary blobs, and optional anchoring information.

anchors.description: Optional anchor records proving statement publication

blobs.description: Binary blobs referenced by statements, keyed by CID

contexts.description: JSON-LD context definitions embedded for self-contained processing

statements.description: Statements included in this manifest, keyed by statement ID

ManifestRegistrationRequest.description: Request body for importing a manifest into a newly created graph.

manifest.description:
Manifest payload to import.
Accepts a manifest object, a JSON string, base64 JSON, or gzip+base64 JSON.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new graph created from this manifest import.

parent_id.description: UUID of the parent graph that the imported graph will be attached to.

ManifestRegistrationResponse.description: Response body returned after a manifest import succeeds.

graph_id.description: UUID of the graph created for the imported manifest.

expiryDate.description: Optional expiry; omitted, null, or empty issues a credential that never expires.

role.description: Optional roles granted to the identity within the project.

subjectDid.description: DID of the agent/identity that belongs to the project.

MetadataStatement.description:
Records metadata associated with a subject

This statement type links metadata (descriptive information, properties,
attributes) to artifacts or entities in the lineage system.

metadata.description: CID of the metadata JSON document

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

subject.description: The subject the metadata describes (CID or DID)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

Payload.description: Defines what type of data is being anchored

description.example: Must ensure equitable access for all individuals and groups.

includeBlobs.description: Whether to include blobs in the manifest

includeContext.description: Whether to populate the context field in the manifest

Signature.description:
Serializable signature within a DSSE envelope.

Links a key identifier to its signature bytes for verification.

keyid.description: Key identifier used to create the signature

SigstoreBundleStatement.description:
Records a Sigstore bundle as a credential

This statement type stores Sigstore bundles which contain signatures
and attestations from the Sigstore transparency log, providing
verifiable proof of software artifact authenticity.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

subject.description: The subject that the bundle is about

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

Statement.description: Enum representing all possible lineage statement types

generate_id.description:
If `true`, the service computes the statement CID and inserts it as `statement.@id`.
If omitted or `false`, the submitted statement must already include a matching `@id` field.

graph_id.description:
The uuid of the graph to register the statement under. This is the uuid used to retrieve
this statement as part of a larger graph.

issue_vc.description: Set to `true` to create a verifiable credential for the statement.

statement.description: Integrity statement JSON. Provide an `@id` field unless `generate_id` is set to `true`.

StorageStatement.description:
Records the storage of data on a specific system

This statement type captures where data is stored and who operated
the storage system, creating an audit trail for data location.

data.description: CID of the data being stored

operatedBy.description: DID of the entity operating the storage system

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

storedOn.description: CID of the storage system description

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created

UrnCidWithSha256.description: A CID reference with its SHA-256 hash for verification

UrnCidWithSha384.description: A CID reference with its SHA-384 hash for verification

VcStatement.description:
Records a W3C Verifiable Credential

This statement type stores verifiable credentials in W3C VC format,
providing cryptographically verifiable claims about subjects.

registeredBy.description: DID of the entity that registered this statement

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the statement was created
